use dep::fuzk;
use mimc::mimc_bn254;
use schnorr::verify_signature;
use std::embedded_curve_ops::EmbeddedCurvePoint;

#[export]
fn main(
    merkle_root: pub Field,
    in_merkle_index_1_1: [bool; 32],
    in_merkle_index_1_2: [bool; 32],
    in_merkle_index_2_1: [bool; 32],
    in_merkle_index_2_2: [bool; 32],
    in_merkle_path_1_1: [Field; 32],
    in_merkle_path_1_2: [Field; 32],
    in_merkle_path_2_1: [Field; 32],
    in_merkle_path_2_2: [Field; 32],
    address: Field,
    in_note_1_1: Field,
    in_note_1_2: Field,
    in_note_2_1: Field,
    in_note_2_2: Field,
    asset1: Field,
    asset2: Field,
    in_amount_1_1: Field,
    in_amount_1_2: Field,
    in_amount_2_1: Field,
    in_amount_2_2: Field,
    in_rho_1_1: Field,
    in_rho_1_2: Field,
    in_rho_2_1: Field,
    in_rho_2_2: Field,
    in_nullifier_1_1: pub Field,
    in_nullifier_1_2: pub Field,
    in_nullifier_2_1: pub Field,
    in_nullifier_2_2: pub Field,
    out_note1: pub Field,
    out_note2: pub Field,
    out_rho1: Field,
    out_rho2: Field,
    out_note_footer1: pub Field,
    out_note_footer2: pub Field,
    pub_key: [Field; 2],
    signature: [u8; 64]
) {
    let fee_ratio_zero:Field = 0;

    assert(in_note_1_1 != in_note_1_2);
    assert(in_note_2_1 != in_note_2_2);

    fuzk::assert_amounts([in_amount_1_1, in_amount_1_2, in_amount_2_1, in_amount_2_2]);

    fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
        merkle_root,
        in_merkle_index_1_1,
        in_merkle_path_1_1,
        address,
        in_note_1_1,
        asset1,
        in_amount_1_1,
        in_rho_1_1,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
        merkle_root,
        in_merkle_index_1_2,
        in_merkle_path_1_2,
        address,
        in_note_1_2,
        asset1,
        in_amount_1_2,
        in_rho_1_2,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
        merkle_root,
        in_merkle_index_2_1,
        in_merkle_path_2_1,
        address,
        in_note_2_1,
        asset2,
        in_amount_2_1,
        in_rho_2_1,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
        merkle_root,
        in_merkle_index_2_2,
        in_merkle_path_2_2,
        address,
        in_note_2_2,
        asset2,
        in_amount_2_2,
        in_rho_2_2,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );

    fuzk::assert_nullifier(in_nullifier_1_1, in_rho_1_1, pub_key);
    fuzk::assert_nullifier(in_nullifier_1_2, in_rho_1_2, pub_key);
    fuzk::assert_nullifier(in_nullifier_2_1, in_rho_2_1, pub_key);
    fuzk::assert_nullifier(in_nullifier_2_2, in_rho_2_2, pub_key);

    fuzk::assert_note(
        out_note1,
        address,
        asset1,
        in_amount_1_1 + in_amount_1_2,
        out_rho1,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_footer(out_note_footer1, out_rho1, pub_key);

    fuzk::assert_note(
        out_note2,
        address,
        asset2,
        in_amount_2_1 + in_amount_2_2,
        out_rho2,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_footer(out_note_footer2, out_rho2, pub_key);

    let signature_domain = 10011;

    let m = mimc_bn254(
        [
        signature_domain,
        in_nullifier_1_1,
        in_nullifier_2_1,
        in_nullifier_1_2,
        in_nullifier_2_2,
        out_note1,
        out_note2
    ]
    );

    let pub_key_point: EmbeddedCurvePoint = EmbeddedCurvePoint { x: pub_key[0], y: pub_key[1] };
    let v = verify_signature(pub_key_point, fuzk::signature_scalars(signature), m);

    assert(v);
}
